nodes.title: START HERE — V2V Hybrid Guides
widgets_values:
# V2V Hybrid Guides · Single Prompt
1. Install the node sources and models listed in the helper repository’s workflows/README.txt. Install the helper repository and the listed public packs, then restart ComfyUI.
2. Put your video in ComfyUI/input and enter `input/your_video.mp4` in Source video. Absolute paths also work.
3. Upload a character image to Reference 1. The included image is only a placeholder. Enable Reference 2 only if your prompt uses it.
4. Write ONE prompt. It is reused for every chunk, including continuation runs. No project or chunk text files are required.
5. Choose a unique run name. Start with Accepted chunks = 0 and New chunks = 1, then Queue.

**Gold = edit. Blue = instructions. Gray = processing.**
Read left to right: run controls → all nine references → models → preparation and sampling. Named Set/Get nodes carry long connections. Double-click a collapsed node to expand it.

nodes.title: PROMPT + CONTINUATION
widgets_values:
## Prompting
Guide mode is ON by default. Use `body_swap:` for the character-swap LoRA, identify `<Picture 1>`, and describe “the guide video”. Add `<Picture 2>` only when Reference 2 is enabled.

Turning guide mode OFF uses Control A as a normal windowed reference instead. Change your wording to `<Video 1>` and choose a suitable LoRA/prompt.

## Continue an accepted run
Keep the run name, version, seed, dimensions, FPS, chunk length and overlap unchanged. Set Accepted chunks to the number to preserve and New chunks to the number to append. The matching video and latent master are selected automatically.

New chunks = 0 renders the remaining source. Use a new run name for a different source or settings. Videos and resume data are saved automatically under ComfyUI/output.

## Reference strip
All nine slots are together, numbered left to right. Reference 1 starts enabled; enable any other slot before using its picture tag. Resize and background-removal nodes are collapsed under each image; expand them to adjust.

nodes.title: SETUP / SOURCES
widgets_values:
## Setup and node sources
All nodes have public GitHub sources. Install Hybrid Guides Helpers and the public packs listed in workflows/README.txt in its repository. The helper package provides single-prompt conditioning, caches and resumable output. A bare workflow JSON still needs these dependencies.

Repository: https://github.com/Jalen-Brunson/ComfyUI-HybridGuides-Helpers

See **README.txt**, **NODE_SOURCES.json** and **MODEL_SOURCES.json** for exact sources and installation locations. No models, private prompts or private media are included.

Baseline: H3 Ref2VA + character-swap v1.1, 7 PDD warmup steps, latent upscale to 1 MP, then 2 DMAD joint steps. Defaults: 24 FPS, 10-second chunk request (243 frames), 39-frame overlap.

Open processing subgraphs with their edit button to inspect the internal nodes.

nodes.title: OPTIONAL CONTROLS
widgets_values:
## Advanced inputs
Inpainting and RefMods default OFF. Supply an inpaint mask video before enabling inpainting. Mask white = regenerate.

The source path also supplies audio and inpaint input. Controls are windowed to the current run automatically. Keep the reference gates consistent with your prompt tags.

References 2–9 start disabled; enable only the pictures you actually use. The reference images are resized and passed through BEN2 background removal as in the original flow. Bypass RMBG when you need the original background.
